name: turnosmart
description: TurnoSmart - gestión de turnos SaaS multi-tenant con scoring de riesgo e IA

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @turnosmart/backend && npm run build -w @turnosmart/frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @turnosmart/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @turnosmart/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @turnosmart/backend && npm run typecheck -w @turnosmart/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @turnosmart/backend
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @turnosmart/backend
